notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The refrigerator remains open while the cabinet and drawer interactions occur. The two upper-cabinet doors are counted separately because each is a distinct hinged part and their opening actions occur at different times.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens the refrigerator, manipulates the two hinged doors of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, opens and closes a utensil/storage drawer beside the oven, closes the upper cabinet, and finally closes the refrigerator.
